scope: Independent actual H2 statement/proof review, with the cap-limit adaptation explicit. Direct unbounded convolution differentiation is not claimed.

pdf_reading.method: Frozen PDF extracted with pdftotext -layout and compared against TeX, actual Lean types and source proofs.

checks.finding: Actual product standard Gaussian, mass, weighted mean/covariance/score, Euclidean squared norm and symmetric nuclear norm; no target bound is assumed.

Upper caps preserve nonnegative log-concavity and positive mass. Mass and second moments dominate each coordinate observable. Bounded Prekopa contraction passes to covariance by dominated convergence and closed quadratic inequalities.
Actual weighted scores and trace converge under caps. Nuclear-norm continuity and the bounded PSD trace decomposition yield exactly the target inequality.

Self-adjoint idempotent P is an actual orthogonal projection. Kernel Gaussian exponential factorization, weighted Jensen and projected Cauchy-Schwarz prove the displayed mean split. Simultaneous caps of weight/reference preserve domination, and all terms and positive mass ratios converge.

route_variations: Bounded log-concave caps and dominated convergence replace direct differentiation of the unbounded convolution.
Finite Gaussian second moments suffice; the additional linear-growth restriction is unnecessary.
Unbounded projected references are reached by simultaneous caps after the literal bounded exponential argument.
limitations: Does not claim the unused unbounded convolution derivative formulas, or any H1/H3/H4 conclusion.
